reading: Ordered rules. For a document and a field, the first rule that applies wins; exceptions go on top. A rule that applies but cannot read its value abstains ([TO CONFIRM]); it never falls through to a looser rule. When a classification is wrong, fix the rule here and rebuild: never the output.

parameters.amount_token_note: The token is the whole run of digits and of every character that can group digits (dot, comma, apostrophes and their look-alikes, any space) when it stands between two digits. It is never cut at a separator the reader does not know: before v2.0.1 it stopped at an apostrophe and EUR 150'000.00 was read as 150.00 (finding T16, blind run of 2026-09-30, eval/history.json run 5). Which groupings are read is decided by dossier/lib/numbers.py; any other abstains.
parameters.amount_guards_note: An amount whose reading is not certain is left unread ([TO CONFIRM]), never shown as fact: when the figure goes on past the token (two separators, a character attached to it), when a magnitude word stands next to it (EUR 150 thousand, Mio. EUR 150), and for every amount of a document that states a scale (in thousands of EUR, TEUR, EUR '000). Added with v2.0.1 (finding T16).
parameters.heading_note_2_0_4: Since v2.0.4 (D30b, forms found by the blind run of v2.0.3, eval/history.json run 11) a heading is read by class in two forms: with its terminal '.' or ':' (holders_heading, directors_heading), and without it (holders_heading_bare, directors_heading_bare) only when the heading is the whole line and the next line is an item of the same list ('4. Shareholders', 'Article 4. Stockholders', 'iv. Quotaholdings', '§ 4 Holders' followed by a holder line). The directors' heading takes the same clause numbers as the holders' heading ('(5) Directors:', '§ 5 Directors', 'Article 5. Directors', 'v. Directors'). Two directors' headings in one document abstain, as two holders' headings do. Still not a heading: a 'current' qualifier in free words ('Shareholders once the transfer has taken effect:') - the table stays unread and the entity blocked (known limit).
parameters.holders_heading_note_2_0_3: Since v2.0.3 (D30, forms found by the blind run of v2.0.2, eval/history.json run 9) the grammar also reads, by class: the qualifier that says 'current' in parentheses or after a comma ('Holders (as at the document date):', 'Holders, now:'); the qualifier that says the holders are the registered ones at the document date ('of record', 'on record', 'registered', 'entered in the register (of members)'), alone or before a 'current' qualifier; the clause numbers '4.', '4)', '4.1.', '(4)', 'IV.', 'Article 4 -'; the nouns 'shareholdings', 'shareholding structure', 'quotaholdings'; the marker of the synthetic world '(synthetic)' at the end. Still not a heading: a qualifier with an explicit date ('Holders at 16 February 2026:'), a qualifier of another time ('before the transfer', 'former'), 'owners', 'beneficial owners', 'ownership structure', 'allocation of the capital', 'directors'.
parameters.holders_heading_note: The heading of a holders' table is a grammar, not a list of phrasings: a holder noun (holders, shareholders, quotaholders, members, partners), optionally numbered, optionally with a qualifier that says the table is current (after the transfer, as at the document date, now), before or after the noun. A qualifier that is not known to mean 'current' (before the transfer, former, as at another date) is not a heading, and the document then abstains on the holders as before. Owners, beneficial owners and directors are not holder nouns. Two headings in one document abstain: which table is current is not ours to choose. Added with v2.0.2 (decision D26 of 2026-09-30: OWN-015 stays 'block'; reworded headings were the first cause of entities blocked wrongly on the stress suite). Since v2.0.6 (D35, hand-14 E-0007): the qualifier of the class 'registered' (of record, registered, entered, recorded or inscribed in the register, ledger or book) may follow the noun after a comma, as a participial clause ('(4) Shareholdings, entered in the register:'); it says the same as without the comma. A participle of another class after a comma is not a heading.
parameters.item_grammar_note_2_0_4: Since v2.0.4 (D30b) the separator may also be a run of three or more dots (dot leaders, '- P-014 (Pia Mendaci) .......... 50%'); the share then never starts with a dot. A line 'Total' with a separator and a share (or a number of quotas or shares) is read only as the LAST line of a holders' table (item_total): the rows are the table, and the Total is recorded as stated_total; a Total that differs from the exact sum of the rows makes the table not sum to the whole, and OWN-010 blocks. A share may stand before the holder ('- 60% P-002 (Bruno Simulanti)', EXT-HOLD-010 item_matches_share_first) when it is a per cent with its sign or word, or a fraction n/d (share_token_first); a share in words or a number of quotas before the holder is not read (the table stays unread, OWN-015).
parameters.item_grammar_note: Since v2.0.3 (D30) a holder line is read by class, not by one literal form: an optional list marker (dash, bullet, '1.', '1)', '(1)', 'a)', '(a)', 'i)', '(i)'); the identifier first with its name in parentheses, or the name first with the identifier in parentheses; a separator (colon, tab, pipe, a dash between spaces, or a space); the share. The share is read by dossier/lib/numbers.py parse_share (per cent with '%', 'per cent', 'percent' or 'pct', a fraction n/d, a whole number of per cent in words, a simple fraction in words); a number of quotas or shares is read only when the same document states the total number once (parameter count_total), and every holder of the table is then counted. Anything else on the line - a second identifier in the name, nested parentheses, a share in another form, a table that mixes counts and shares - leaves the whole table unread, as before.
parameters.count_total_note: A number of quotas or shares is a share of the entity only through the total. The total is read from the same document, and only when these patterns find one value (the same value found twice is one value); no total, or two different totals, and the counts are not read: the table is [TO CONFIRM] and OWN-015 blocks. The counts of a table are divided by that total and summed like any other share, so counts that do not add up to the total make a table that does not sum (OWN-010). Added with v2.0.3 (D30).
parameters.slot_note_2_0_5: Since v2.0.5 (D34): the slots of rules/extract.json classified_lines. The share of a line of a list (rule CLS-020) is typed too: a share or a number of quotas or shares that is read, or a figure that is not read (slot_share_unread: no letter but those of per cent, quotas or shares); a share in any other words leaves the line open. A slot is typed: an amount (slot_amount: EUR or € before the figure, euro after it, or a number in words before euro), a number of quotas or shares (slot_count), a company name (capitalised words and Italian particles, at most eight, then S.r.l., S.p.A., S.a.s. or S.n.c.), a person's name (at most five capitalised words, particles or initials), an address (a street of at most six words, a house number, a town of at most four words, a province of two capitals in parentheses, optionally ' - interno', ' - scala' or ' - piano' and a mark). A capitalised word holds letters and apostrophes only: no figure, no identifier (P-001, E-0001), no punctuation. The free words of a slot (groups named w_...) go through the same test as an unread document (the topic rules of unread_fields and holders_evidence) and may name only the fields of their rule. title_nouns and closing_sentence are shared by FEV-920, FEV-930 and the rules CLS-900, CLS-910. slot_subscribed_paid names the clause 'fully subscribed and fully paid in' and its closed variants; slot_label_words is the label of CLS-250 (at most eight words of letters, no figure).
parameters.slot_own_name_note: Since v2.0.6 (D35): a slot that holds the entity's own name (the deed's 'is named', the extract's 'Name:', a label line with a company name) closes its line only when it is the name of the document's own header 'Entity:', spaces collapsed and the legal form at its end set aside (rules/discrepancy.json legal_form_in_name: a legal form that differs is DISC-035's, not a word of the name). Any other word makes it differ: the line falls to the next rule, and to CLS-999. A document whose header names no entity has no own name to compare: its slots are judged by slot_not_name_word only.
parameters.slot_note_2_0_6: Since v2.0.6 (D35, probes E-0011 and E-0012 of the blind run of v2.0.5, eval/history.json run 14): a slot that holds a name - a person, a company, a street or a town (the groups of slot_name_groups, and the name beside an identifier in a list line) - holds only words that can be part of a name. Every word of it (a run of letters) is tested, case ignored, against slot_not_name_word, by class: role and office nouns, nouns and adjectives of holding and ownership (sole, owner, proprietress, holder, member, majority...), adverbs of time and manner (henceforth, now, until, since...), English function words (articles, pronouns, auxiliaries, prepositions, conjunctions), the Italian words of role, holding and time, and the endings of English words that no Italian name has (-ly, -forth, -after, -ward(s), -ship, -hood, -ness, -ess, -trix, -tion, -sion, -ment, -ity, -ous, -ed). One such word and the slot names every field: no rule closes the line, which falls to CLS-999 (the document may change every field, DISC-006; the line is checked for holdings, OWN-015). The person slot of 2.0.5 admitted 'Hilde Simulanti Sole Proprietress Henceforth' (five capitalised words) with no check; a capitalised word that is none of these classes still passes this test, so the name beside an identifier is also compared with its own value where one is known (CLS-005).

holders_evidence.reading: A document whose type is not recognised is not read for facts (DISC-005 keeps every field it may change [TO CONFIRM]). Its body is still checked for holders' tables, so that it does not block the entity for nothing (OWN-015): every table under a holders' heading (parameter holders_heading) is read with the item grammar of EXT-HOLD-010 and summed; every other body line goes through these rules, first match wins, after the phrases of neutral_phrases are removed. One line decided as evidence, one table not read whole, two tables, or a header that cannot be read, and the document stays 'not read': it blocks the entity as before. The rules err on the side of evidence: a line wrongly taken as evidence costs coverage, a line wrongly passed could hide a table that does not sum. Added with v2.0.2 (decision D26 of 2026-09-30).

unread_fields.reading: Which fields a document whose type is not recognised may change (DISC-005, parameter unread_document_scope of rules/discrepancy.json). Checked only when the type is the header's only problem; a document with any other header problem may change every field. Every body line outside a holders' table read whole goes through these rules. The rules marked 'topic' are all tried: a line may speak of several fields, and every field it may speak of is kept. Only when no topic rule applies are the others tried, in order, first match wins: a figure, an identifier, an amount or a label that no topic explains makes the document one that may change every field; a holders' heading, a title marked as invented and a closing sentence saying the document states nothing more state no field; any other line may change every field (default FEV-999). The shareholders are decided by the holders' check (holders_evidence): a table read whole may change them, 'no_table' does not. The rules err on the side of evidence: a word wrongly taken as a topic costs coverage (the field stays [TO CONFIRM]), a line wrongly passed could let a fact be shown that the unread document contradicts. Added with v2.0.3 (D30: on the perturbed corpus of seed 20261013 a document of unrecognised type left every field of its entity [TO CONFIRM], including fields it does not speak of).

classified_lines.reading: Since v2.0.5 (D34, the limit 'may publish' of v2.0.4): every non-empty body line of a document whose type is recognised is decided by these rules, first match wins. A document of a recognised type is read for the fields of its kind only; these rules say which of its lines state those fields and nothing else. A line is explained when it has no letter or digit, when it is a line of a list read under a heading of its kind (or of a holders' table in a document of any kind), when the whole line is a shape of its kind whose typed slots (parameters slot_...) name no other field by the test of an unread document, or when it is a title or a closing sentence. Any other line (default CLS-999) makes the document one that may change every field of its entity: stage 3 keeps every field [TO CONFIRM] when the document is not older than the latest event of the field (DISC-006, the criterion of DISC-005), and the line is checked for holdings as a line of an unread document is (holders_evidence: a holding outside a table read whole and OWN-015 blocks). A closed line states nothing but the fields of its rule: when a rule of the kind read one of them from another line (a second clause, a second list), the line was not read and the document may change that field (DISC-006 keeps it [TO CONFIRM] under the same date criterion). A holders' table in a document of a kind that is not read for holders (resolution, appointment, office transfer, financial summary) is read whole and summed (OWN-010), or OWN-015 blocks; read whole, it may change the shareholders. The rules err on the side of the open line: a shape not listed here costs coverage (every field [TO CONFIRM]), a shape too wide could let an older value be shown as fact.

rules.rationale: Since v2.0.6 (D35, probe E-0011 of run 14), an exception on top: the name beside an identifier is a slot whose own value is known - for a person, the name the identity layer gives for the identifier (identity/persons.json of the input, when present); for a company, a name that the entity's own documents give in their header (Entity:). A line where the name beside a known identifier is not that name (spaces collapsed, nothing else normalised) holds more than its own value: no rule closes it, the document may change every field (DISC-006) and the line is checked for holdings (OWN-015). An identifier whose name is not known is judged by the slot test alone (slot_not_name_word).

rules.rationale: A label and a typed value, the whole line (since v2.0.5): a label of at most eight words that names fields of the kind only (the test of an unread document), then one to four amounts, an address, a company name, a legal form, or nothing (the heading of a list). The line states the fields of the kind that both the label and the type of the value name (value_topics; a heading: the holders or the directors), and nothing else; a label that names none of them does not close the line. The free words of the value may name only those fields. No rule read the line: the document may change those fields (DISC-006).
